description: Every pixel whose stable-pass output changed at the golden raster (ADR 0010), with its dd adjudication. c is the golden-raster pixel centre of (x, y) for the corpus viewport (createViewportTransform, prepareRealColumns). Aggregates in semantic-comparison.json and summary.md are derived views.

fieldNotes.analyticError: |lambda_after - lambda_dd|; null when dd did not certify period 3
fieldNotes.beforeError: |lambda_before - lambda_dd| when the pixel was already period 3, else null
